1000% Produktempfehlung!!! Schnelle Lieferung, super easy im Aufbau, tolle Qualität, sehr stabil. Mein 30 kg Dobermann liebt den Wagen. Aufgrund von einer OP durfte mein Hund nicht laufen. Mit dem Wagen haben wir so viel Lebensqualität zurück bekommen. Hatte zuerst bedenken, dass aufgrund des sehr günstigen Preises die Qualität billig ist. Genau das Gegenteil ist der Fall. Ich kann jedem Hundebesitzer nur zum Kauf raten! Eine absolute Produktempfehlung!

Excellent pet stroller. Very spacious, smooth riding, easy to put up. My 3 Pugs and I absolutely love this stroller and we are our walking often. Two of my Pugs have Laxating Patella in their back knees. I think if this stroller ever broke I would buy 2 more! 😊

Very nice stroller for medium to large dogs. We got it for our 45lb terrier mix while she recovers from ACL/CCL surgery. She can get in and out on her own with ease and seems happy with the visibility. Rear wheels are very big, so we have to fold it flat to fit through our apartment door, which isn’t ideal. However, everything else is perfect so we are happy. Went together easily and feels sturdy. It should also be a nice shelter for summer trips to the beach, so bonus! UPDATE: wow…so thankful every day for this thing! Our girl has recovered from surgery, but she still loves the stroller! We use it now to bring her to the park, so she doesn’t get heat fatigue on the way there and back! Attached a carrying bag for a collapsable bowl and a thermos of water and some toys, and we put a small rechargeable fan inside for the 100 degree weather. Best money spent in a long time! In terms of durability, we realized very quickly this is NOT for off-road use. We tried a few times and it felt like the wheels would break. We stick to paved paths and lock it with a bike lock when we get to the park. Other than the wheels needing oil, we have had no problems with daily use over the last 4 months.

This through-wall drop box has completely solved my mail security issues. The heavy-duty steel construction feels sturdy and durable, with a clean dark gray finish that resists scratches and weathering. The combination lock is easy to set and operate, no more worrying about lost keys. The anti-theft baffle inside prevents fishing, and the rainproof design keeps all mail dry even during heavy downpours. Installation was straightforward with clear instructions, and it fits perfectly into my exterior wall. Great for home and small business use.
